authority: Original Citation Dominance strategy reconciled with the repo-local Velocity-only publishing contract.

operating_model.site_role: source-backed editorial decision-support and citation surface
operating_model.provider_role: registered canonical destination sites own current provider discovery and transactional routing

external_or_deferred: verified provider records remain empty until a documented, legally usable source and owner approval are supplied
named professional reviewer records remain empty until credentials, approval, scope, and profile are independently verified
measurement in Semrush or AI visibility platforms

validator_policy.hard_fail: Only release integrity, safety, evidence, route, canonical, build, workflow, and packaging defects block release.
validator_policy.warning: Growth opportunities, external authority work, off-site distribution, optional AI files, and copy preferences do not block release.
validator_policy.dynamic_inventory: Current registries define expected counts; historical counts are floors or immutable fixtures, never equality locks.
validator_policy.cosmetic_formatting: Trailing whitespace, blank lines, indentation, and exact copy never block release.

current_platform_reconciliation.google_ai_search: Foundational SEO and non-commodity content govern; AEO/GEO are not separate Google ranking systems.
current_platform_reconciliation.faq_schema: Optional semantic markup only; Google FAQ rich results were removed in May/June 2026.
current_platform_reconciliation.llms_txt: Supplemental for services that use it; Google Search ignores it for ranking and visibility.
current_platform_reconciliation.query_fanout: Used for research and internal linking, not to justify one thin page per wording variation.
current_platform_reconciliation.indexnow: Valid for participating engines; HTTP 200 proves receipt, not indexing.
